content.short: BuidlGuidl is a DAO serving as the community and incentivization layer around Scaffold-ETH and SpeedRunEthereum.com.
content.description: BuidlGuidl is a decentralized autonomous organization that acts as the community and incentives layer for Scaffold-ETH and SpeedRunEthereum.com. For beginners, Scaffold-ETH provides a practical base to experiment with Solidity, while SpeedRunEthereum.com gamifies the learning path with challenges that test and showcase skills. Developers participate in these challenges together through the BuidlGuidl community, collaborating, sharing solutions, and advancing as they build, test, and ship smart contracts.
